Platform features

Built around the European student journey

Every feature in Euroscope is designed to simplify a specific pain point in the study-abroad process — from first lead to arrival in Europe.

Core features

Everything your European journey needs

A complete platform built around the realities of European university admissions and visa preparation.

Student Management

Manage student profiles, academic information, application history, and emergency contacts in one secure record.

University & Course Discovery

Explore European universities and available study opportunities across eight supported destinations.

Application Management

Track applications from submission through to final decision, with a clear stage-by-stage pipeline.

Document Management

Upload, organize, review, and track required documents — with status flags and audit trail.

Visa Management

Manage visa preparation, requirements, appointments, biometrics, and decision tracking.

Tasks & Deadlines

Never lose track of important university and visa deadlines. Tasks are scoped per student and per application.

Payments & Invoices

Track service payments, invoices, and financial information with role-based access control.

Communication

Keep students and employees connected with role-aware messaging and notifications.

Reports & Analytics

Monitor applications, students, visas, and business performance across branches.

Role-Based Access

Secure, granular permissions for Admin, Employee, and Student roles — every action is audit-logged.

Your European future starts here.

Plan your studies, manage your application, and move forward with confidence.
